basic_info.description: Bright and inviting 2BD/1BA top-floor home in a charming 2-unit building on one of Cow Hollow's most desirable tree-lined streets. Enjoy expansive Presidio views from the living and dining areas, an updated kitchen with skylight, fireplace, in-unit laundry, and generous storage. Peek-a-boo Bay and Alcatraz views from the bedrooms. Includes one-car (tandem) parking, shared backyard, new roof, and roof rights. Unbeatable location with easy access to the Presidio, the Marina, and Marin.
